criteria.notes: Departure board: time, destination, flight, gate, terminal and status per row, with terminal identity, local clock and a standing advisory footer.
Keeps the airport flight-information-display concept: yellow identity band, monospaced-feel rows, colour-coded status chips.
Reads as an airport FIDS board, not a generic table widget; full-bleed rows with a dedicated status column.
Destination and time columns sit above the distance-viewing floors now that auto-fit resolves properly instead of pinning to the minimum.
Light-theme scenario keeps status chips legible against pale rows; the default holds yellow-on-black at full strength.
Long-label and maximum-content scenarios keep destination names complete; row count adapts by paging rather than shrinking type.
Rows fill the board at full counts. Sparse states show fewer rows against the board field, which is how a real departures display behaves, and the empty state substitutes a centred message.
Identity mark and status chips render crisply from 600x600 through 1920x1080; no raster media involved.
The yellow-banded transit board is visually distinct from the dashboard and editorial examples.
